description: We have all felt dizzy upon standing up too quickly and wondered, "Am I really that old?" Now, imagine an astronaut who, after months in microgravity, lands and gravity pulls their blood back down into their legs, potentially causing them to faint. On the Moon or Mars, there would be no rescue. We are developing an app that provides step-by-step guidance through a standing test to determine whether the astronaut is ready to walk, should wait, or ought to remain where they are.
